pages.text: The Soulium Spawner is used to spawn both hostile and passive mobs using Essences. They run off of solid fuels and have an internal power storage buffer. $(br2)The Spawner has an internal inventory that can hold up to 512 items. Each operation will take a certain amount of items and power to spawn a corresponding mob.

pages.title: Створіння
pages.text: The Spawner will spawn the mob randomly in a 3 block radius around it. $(br2)These machines can upgraded with $(l:machines/machine_upgrades)Machine Upgrades$(). $(br2)The Soulium Spawner can be de-activated with a Redstone signal.
